plan: Added title validation to POST /todos (trim, 1-200 characters, JSON 400 errors, 64 KiB body cap), then tests and docs in parallel.
rationale: Impact analysis showed the handler passed input straight to the store with an unbounded body read, so validation and the size cap went in the handler as a pure, testable function.
risks: Error body format change for malformed JSON.
limitations: Existing invalid todos are not migrated.
